cards.title: Methane & GHG Emissions
cards.description: Anaerobic decomposition of untreated organic waste in open landfills generates massive methane spikes, accelerating climate degradation.

cards.title: Groundwater Leachate
cards.description: Rainfall washes toxic decomposing fluids into soil matrices, contaminating local freshwater aquifers and irrigation channels.

cards.title: Public Health Risks
cards.description: Open decomposition sites attract flies, rodents, and bacteria, increasing disease vectors near high-density market zones.

images.title: Decomposing Food Scrap Heap
images.caption: Highlights wet organic biomass rotting anaerobically, generating severe odor, breeding vectors, and potent methane emissions.

sections.heading: Organic Plant Pellets
sections.subHeading: Value-Added Bio-Fertilizers Engineered for Soil Health

cards.title: Nutrient Densification
cards.description: Compacting dehydrated organic waste into uniform pellets concentrated with Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium (NPK).

cards.title: Slow-Release Mechanism
cards.description: Provides steady, long-term soil feeding preventing nutrient runoff caused by chemical fertilizers.

cards.title: Soil Microbe Boost
cards.description: Restores living organic matter and microbial biodiversity to depleted agricultural soils.

images.title: Compressed Bio-Fertilizer Granules
images.caption: Close-up of actual organic fertilizer pellets, showcasing uniform granule structure designed for easy broadcast and soil blending.

images.title: Enriched Agricultural Soil
images.caption: Demonstrates rich, moisture-retaining soil fed by organic matter, supporting resilient root establishment and microbial health.

processSteps.title: Collection & Segregation
processSteps.desc: Sourcing clean vegetable waste from hotels and markets.

processSteps.title: Size Reduction
processSteps.desc: Shredding and chopping to increase surface area and drying efficiency.

processSteps.title: Dehydration
processSteps.desc: Removing excess moisture using solar, tray, or hot-air dryers.

processSteps.title: Grinding & Formulation
processSteps.desc: Pulverizing into powder and formulating for nutrient consistency.

processSteps.title: Quality Testing
processSteps.desc: Testing for NPK, organic carbon, pH, heavy metals, and physical strength.

processSteps.title: Plant Testing & Packaging
processSteps.desc: Conducting growth trials and sealing into moisture-resistant packages (1kg to 25kg).

images.title: Industrial Extrusion & Milling
images.caption: Features high-performance agricultural machinery performing mechanical shredding and pellet formation.
